answer.text: Conjecture without firm evidence of asset value and a profit motive with risk not fully considered

explanation.text: The Logic: Page 14 describes speculation as conjecture without firm evidence, no cognizance of asset value, and a profit motive with little risk consideration. The Trap: Treating short-term activity as speculation is a tendency and not appropriate per the source; income generation and capital preservation are investment objectives. Note: Source-backed by NISM-XXI-A page 14.
